items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I'd get Billie Holiday and she'd come up and sing some tunes with us

ctx.x: That was a great honor for me.

Right, right. She sang the blues. These are the things that are so rewarding to a musician, like, down through the years, when I was at the club, at the DeLisa and things like that, and we dragged the people up, and I'd get Billie Holiday and she'd come up and sing some tunes with us and things like that.
These are the things that -- they're treasures.
